table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode , 
	suppcode=purledger.suppcode,
	dbo.accounts.name , 
	username=users.username,
	dbo.purledger.date, 
	dbo.purledger.invtotal,
	posted = purledger.posted,
	PostedBy = ISNULL((SELECT u.username FROM users u WHERE u.usercode=purledger.postedby),''),
	ModifiedBy = ISNULL((SELECT u.username FROM users u WHERE u.usercode=purledger.ModifiedBy),''),
	Remarks = purledger.remarks ,
	purchasetype=(select name from purchasetype where purchasetype.purtypecode=purledger.purtypecode),
	Pushed=purledger.Pushed,
	PushedOn=purledger.PushedOn,
	PushedBy=IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.purledger.PushedBy = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	PushedFor = IsNull((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.InstanceID + ')' FROM Site S WHERE S.SiteCode=PurLedger.TargetSiteCode),'')
FROM  
	dbo.purledger , 
	dbo.accounts ,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory = 'Y' AND
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and 
	dbo.purledger.purcatcode = 3 and
	dbo.purledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode and
	Posted IN (:as_Posted) AND
	(
	dbo.PurLedger.HeaderNo IS NULL OR
	dbo.PurLedger.HeaderNo IN (SELECT HeaderCode FROM GroupAllowedHeader WHERE GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode AND Module = :ai_Module)
	) and
	Exists (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('allowedgroupsinpurchaselist') 
			WHERE DBO.Fn_GetPreference('allowedgroupsinpurchaselist') = 'N')
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode , 
	suppcode=purledger.suppcode,
	dbo.accounts.name , 
	username=users.username,
	dbo.purledger.date, 
	dbo.purledger.invtotal,
	posted = purledger.posted,
	PostedBy = ISNULL((SELECT u.username FROM users u WHERE u.usercode=purledger.postedby),''),
	ModifiedBy = ISNULL((SELECT u.username FROM users u WHERE u.usercode=purledger.ModifiedBy),''),
	Remarks = purledger.remarks ,
	purchasetype=(select name from purchasetype where purchasetype.purtypecode=purledger.purtypecode),
	Pushed=purledger.Pushed,
	PushedOn=purledger.PushedOn,
	PushedBy=IsNull((Select username from users 
							where dbo.purledger.PushedBy = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	PushedFor = IsNull((SELECT S.Name + ' (' + S.InstanceID + ')' FROM Site S WHERE S.SiteCode=PurLedger.TargetSiteCode),'')
FROM  
	dbo.purledger , 
	dbo.accounts ,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	dbo.purledger.ImpactInventory = 'Y' AND
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and 
	dbo.purledger.purcatcode = 3 and
	Posted IN (:as_Posted) AND
	dbo.purledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode and
	(dbo.PurLedger.HeaderNo IS NULL OR
	dbo.PurLedger.HeaderNo IN 
		(SELECT HeaderCode FROM GroupAllowedHeader 
		WHERE GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode AND Module = :ai_Module)) and
	dbo.PurLedger.salesmancode IN 
		(Select 	Distinct U.usercode
		From   	Users U, UserGroups UG, GroupAllowedGroups GAG
		Where  	U.UserCode = UG.UserCode And UG.GroupCode = GAG.AllowedGroupCode And 
				GAG.GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode And GAG.Module = :ai_Module
		Union 
		Select   U.Usercode
		From     Users U, UserGroups UG
		Where    U.usercode = UG.usercode And UG.GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode) And
	Exists (SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('allowedgroupsinpurchaselist') 
			WHERE DBO.Fn_GetPreference('allowedgroupsinpurchaselist') = 'Y')
